result_text:
I fixed the typos in six default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The existing `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't write any new tests, so the new `.htm`, `.xml`, `.js` and `-gradle.js` matches haven't been run against real file paths.

- **HTML generators:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **Generated `.js` and `.xml`:** the `// Generated by …` rule and the .NET `<doc>` rule used `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml`. Those only match a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`.
- **Gradle script:** the build-and-deployment rule used `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` is covered by a separate rule that I didn't touch.

I left the content patterns alone, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files only land in these scopes if their first lines match the generator marker.
